title: p2p cribbage
tagline: p2p cribbage is both a game and alt mempool that connects useroperations to bundlers
description:
The problems being solved are as follows:

- Play cribbage with zero intermediaries after a round of central routing peer exchange
- Store music onchain via strudel.cycles tunes to play during game. Person with highest score has their music play → Browser compatibility issues
- Use the browser background process and storage as an memort alt-pool for account abstraction UserOperations
- Log your playing with NFTs (sound as ERC1155 & games as ERC721) → Future
how_its_made: Is built using the stack of fluence, sequence, polygon and hypercore. The application has embedded alt pool is built into the frontend, where bundlers run in a nodejs process can pluck UserOperations from for on-chain transactions. Cards are dealt and sent via p2p protocols to the other member.
